Reference / os/directory

os/directory#

WorkingDirectory denotes the process working directory without changing it.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let working = WorkingDirectory();
output.writeln(working.path().string());

Description#

WorkingDirectory denotes the process working directory without changing it. Its constructor performs no runtime work; path() observes the directory at the moment it is called:

It can be passed directly to APIs that need a directory location:

for DirectoryEntries(origin: working) -> entry {
    output.writeln(entry.path().string());
}

This module deliberately exposes no process-global chdir operation. Supply a DirectoryLocating object explicitly to commands and filesystem objects.

Public API#

object WorkingDirectory#

object WorkingDirectory does DirectoryLocating

The directory the process runs in, read when asked; it is never changed.
